function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace && S=outputs/skill/scripts/gen_animation.py && SC=outputs/skill/assets/scaffold.js && R=outputs/fixtures/results &&
echo '--- T1: 缺少canvas字段 ---' &&
echo '{"title":"x"}' > $R/bad1.json &&
python3 $S --config $R/bad1.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad1.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T2: 非法JSON ---' &&
echo '{title: nope' > $R/bad2.json &&
python3 $S --config $R/bad2.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad2.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T3: canvas.height为负 ---' &&
echo '{"title":"x","canvas":{"width":100,"height":-5}}' > $R/bad3.json &&
python3 $S --config $R/bad3.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad3.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T4: topic缺少TopicSim ---' &&
echo 'window.nothing = 1;' > $R/bad_topic.js &&
python3 $S --config outputs/fixtures/skating/config.json --topic $R/bad_topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad4.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T5: config文件不存在 ---' &&
python3 $S --config $R/nonexistent.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad5.html; echo "exit=$?"
ls $R/bad*.html 2>/dev/null || echo '未产生任何bad*.html输出(符合预期)'
} 2>&1 | tee $R/badinput_tests.txt","timeoutSeconds":60,"title":"坏输入行为实测(T1-T5)"}
